EmailTemplate.description: A post-drive thank you email to BPLs with drive results.
EmailTemplate.name: Evergreen_General_Thank You Post Drive Results
EmailTemplate.subject: Results for your recent blood drive!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear [BPL Name],
Thank you for coordinating the [Date] blood drive. The efforts of [Account Name] have always been greatly appreciated and their support of the community blood program will go a long way toward replenishing blood supplies and ultimately saving lives.
The results of your blood drive are as follows:
[#] donors registered [#] donors deferred [#] units collected [#] first time donors
In the coming days, you will receive an email with a brief satisfaction survey. We have updated our survey questions to make it a more concise and easier experience for you. Your response to the survey is essential for the Red Cross to continually evaluate your overall experience and satisfaction. We want to hear from your because your voice matters!
Again, thank you for your contribution and ongoing support of this important community program. I look forward to working with you again on an upcoming blood drive.
Sincerely, [Account Representative Name] [Contact Information]
